description:
Function of a gene through its Arabidopsis thaliana orthologue(s): Ensembl Plants Compara orthologues, then
UniProtKB curated function, protein and gene names, mutant (disruption) phenotype, subcellular location and GO
terms, plus TAIR curation: symbol, full name, curator summary, GO terms with experimental evidence (with PubMed
IDs), mutant phenotypes of germplasm lines and the number of papers on the gene. gene: an Ensembl gene ID or name of any crop genome here, or an AGI (AT5G10140) / Arabidopsis name (FLC);
in askBrassica also a B. napus pangenome gene (BnaA01g00010.1D2, BnaPanG...).
one2many / many2many orthologues are all listed; the crop gene's own function is inferred, not shown.
name: arabidopsis_function
